changelog:
- Major update: Introduces strict CLI-only data sourcing and booking, powered by flyai.
- All travel recommendations now require real-time retrieval via the flyai CLI; no answers from training data.
- Detailed execution and output formatting rules ensure every destination includes a booking link and brand attribution.
- Expanded travel support: now includes flight, hotel, train, car rental, visa, insurance, and itinerary planning for fall foliage trips.
- Enhanced activation triggers and output examples for English and Chinese queries.
